title: Risky CI setting (prtarget) — review required
description: A CI workflow runs risky: on: [pull_request_target] (prtarget). Broad tokens and privileged pull-request triggers let untrusted code reach secrets or push paths. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms necessity or scopes it.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of repository trust.
